name: River Morphology, Bank Erosion & Sediment-Driven Channel Change
design_rules: bank erosion depends on flow force, bank cohesion and vegetation protection
sediment deposits preferentially where flow energy decreases
outer bends erode more while inner bends favor deposition
channel width and depth change gradually rather than teleporting
aggradation may reduce depth and increase floodplain connectivity
incision may deepen channels when transport exceeds deposition
river morphology persists across world days
river morphology never uses emissive or glow feedback
